# Text-only Hero

`hero/text-only` &middot; section-level &middot; category: hero

## Purpose

A large, typography-led hero with no image: display headline, description and button.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `headline` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eyebrow` | text |  |
| `description` | text |  |
| `cta` | cta { label, href } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Display headline on the surface color.
- **dark**: White text on the primary brand color. Sets `background: @colors.primary`, `buttonBackground: @colors.primaryText`, `buttonColor: @colors.primary`.
- **accent**: White text on the accent color. Sets `background: @colors.accent`, `buttonBackground: @colors.white`, `buttonColor: @colors.accent`.
- **left**: Left-aligned display headline. Sets `align: left`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `textColor` | text | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `eyebrowColor` | text | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `buttonBackground` | color | `"@colors.primary"` |
| `buttonColor` | color | `"@colors.primaryText"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.3xl @theme.section.paddingX @spacing.3xl @theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.md"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text and colors honored. | Fine, no image to drop. | Swaps on the brand surface. Dark and accent variants keep their colors. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('hero/text-only', {
  "eyebrow": "This weekend only",
  "headline": "Up to 40% off the summer edit",
  "description": "Our biggest sale of the season. Ends Sunday at midnight.",
  "cta": {
    "label": "Shop the sale",
    "href": "https://example.com/collections/sale"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "hero/text-only",
  "data": {
    "eyebrow": "This weekend only",
    "headline": "Up to 40% off the summer edit",
    "description": "Our biggest sale of the season. Ends Sunday at midnight.",
    "cta": {
      "label": "Shop the sale",
      "href": "https://example.com/collections/sale"
    }
  }
}
```
